We have already explained above that things advance gradually: The Hevel of the Awzen is unfelt. A little bit of Hevel comes out of the Hotem, and the Hevel of the Hotem is less than the Hevel of the Peh, though they are all equal in that they raise Hevel.
However, the Ayin has no Hevel, only Histaklut. The reason for this difference is that the three are Behinat Taamim, but the Ayin is Behinat Nekudot SAG, which is below the degree of Taamim.
